notes.content: [p][b]KARATE ROGUE Demo Ver.0.250928[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a progression-blocking bug that could occur immediately after [b]New Game[/b] on certain environments. We’re sorry for the trouble.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Awakening Skill “Gale Onslaught”[/b] increased [b]ACT[/b] but still ended the turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized several English [b]skill[/b] and [b]weapon[/b] descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the motion for the [b]ART “Spinning Back Kick.”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked early-game flow and some lines right after [b]New Game[/b].[/p][/*][/list]
